description:
Donations are tax deductible and we need your support to continue our work. Text-to-donate, text VSRF to 53555.Show more This Thursday on VSRF Live, we bring together a rare and formidable panel of scientists, frontline healthcare professionals, policy experts, and national advocates to assess the real state of medical freedom in America — not as it appears in press releases, but as it is being lived by families, students, and healthcare workers right now.
Even as HHS leadership has begun scaling back federal vaccine recommendations and elevating nutrition as a cornerstone of health, a growing number of states are waging a quiet but coordinated effort to reverse those gains.
The critical question we confront: Are coercive health policies being dismantled at all if states and institutions can simply disregard the very federal authorities they once cited to justify mandates?
From hospitals and universities to licensing boards and school systems, enforcement is accelerating quietly, exemptions are being denied, and careers are being derailed, often without public debate or meaningful media scrutiny.
What We’ll Break Down
Medical Freedom: A State of the Union
A clear-eyed assessment of where things actually stand nationwide, and why recent federal announcements may offer far less protection than many assume.
Federal Signals vs. State Crackdowns
As talk of scaling back the CDC vaccine schedule circulates, several states are escalating mandates, tightening enforcement, and expanding requirements across education, healthcare, and employment.
Healthcare Students Under Fire
Disturbing cases emerging from Connecticut and beyond, where medical and healthcare students are being denied even medical exemptions, jeopardizing years of training and future careers before they begin.
Religious Liberty Under Pressure
With renewed attention following the formation of President Trump’s Religious Liberty Commission, we examine where religious protections stand, how they’re being challenged, and why exemptions remain one of the most contested fronts in this fight.
Inside the System
Firsthand insight into what’s happening behind closed doors, from hospital compliance offices to regulatory agencies, and why public awareness is urgently needed.
This Week’s Panel
Aimee Villella McBride — executive director of the Global Wellness Forum and longtime health-freedom leader, bringing decades of communications experience and frontline advocacy for families navigating mandates, exclusion, and loss of rights.
Dian Dossias — national health-freedom advocate and leader of Stop College Mandates, exposing how students — particularly those entering healthcare professions — are being blocked from clinicals and degree completion despite valid exemptions.
Nurse Nicole — a veteran acute-care bedside nurse continuing to work inside hospital systems while advocating for informed consent, bodily autonomy, and the rights of healthcare workers who refused mandates and faced retaliation.
Dr. James Lyons-Weiler — scientist, author, and president of the Institute for Pure and Applied Knowledge, bringing a rigorous analytical lens to biomedical policy, data integrity, and the widening gap between public-health claims and real-world outcomes.
Elyse Young — founder of Guiding the Impact and seasoned policy professional whose work on religious liberty, parental rights, and educational access is informed by her family’s forced departure from New York under coercive mandates.
This is not a theoretical discussion. Policies are advancing quietly, enforcement is becoming more localized, and resistance is often fragmented or delayed. The consequences for every American are immediate and deeply personal.
📺 Join us live for a timely, unfiltered conversation about the state of health freedom and how to protect it.
⏰ Time: 7 pm ET, 4 pm PT
